primitives.name: Stripe Customer Deduplication
primitives.verbatim_quote: Same user → same key → Stripe dedupes the customer create, so a retry/parallel checkout can't mint a second customer.
primitives.assumptions: Assumes idempotency key generation and Stripe API de-duplication behavior
primitives.breakdown_regime: Duplicate customer creation due to network retries or parallel requests

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE transaction idempotency through unique external order IDs

primitives.name: Unmapped Price Active Renewal Guard
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Unmapped price on ACTIVE paid renewal** — tier is **held, never downgraded**: the defensive no-downgrade guard in the webhook (`tier === "FREE" && priceId && statusGrantsAccess && existingIsPaid` → retain `existing.tier` + alert).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes webhook processing order and existing subscription state
primitives.breakdown_regime: Downgrade prevention during active subscription renewal with invalid pricing

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI subscription downgrade prevention via explicit tier retention logic
layer2.telemetry: Subscription tier changes observed during webhook processing
